description: For subsets \(A\) and \(B\) of any type, \(A\) is eventually contained in \(B\) along the cofinite filter if and only if \(A\) minus \(B\) is finite.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.almostSubset_iff_finite_sdiff.{u} {α : Type u} (A B : Set α) :
  A ≤ᶠ[Filter.cofinite] B ↔ (A \ B).Finite
